title: Bulk scan-and-mark + per-pupil feedback comments + MIS export
description: Push ScanMark from one stack to: auto-mark a class set in 90 seconds with whole-class analytics afterwards; per-pupil feedback comments generated from each pupil's actual answers (not generic — uses the misconceptions they made); a marksheet that exports straight to the school's MIS (SIMS / Bromcom / Arbor / Edukey / Provision Map) so the teacher never re-types a grade; an optional voice-marking mode for phone use.
rationale: User's improvement #11 — 'the marking ends here' promise. The single-page ScanMarkDialog (PR #32) already proves the per-pupil pipeline works. Going from one to thirty is the change that earns the SENCO/HOD endorsement. MIS export is the integration that removes the last manual step.
constraints: Must reuse the existing /api/ai/scan-mark Gemini Vision endpoint. No new paid Vision API.
Must not block the UI on bulk scan — show progress, allow cancel.
Voice marking is desktop-side speech only (Web Speech API). No paid TTS, no server-side audio.
MIS export is CSV-first (every UK MIS imports CSV). Native MIS APIs (Wonde, GroupCall) come in Phase C — this PR only emits the file.
steps: - scanBatch(images: File[], expectedAnswers, opts): AsyncGenerator<ScanBatchProgress, ScanBatchResult[]>
Iterates images sequentially (Vision endpoint has a 25MB cap per call already). Yields {processed, total, currentPupilName, perPupilResult, error?} so the UI can drive a progress bar without polling.
- aggregateBatch(results): { perQuestion: { idx; pctCorrect; meanMarks; commonMisconceptions: string[] }[]; perPupil: { pupilId; pctCorrect; gaps: misconceptionId[] }[] } — pure.

- generateBulkFeedback(results, worksheet): Promise<{ pupilId; comment: string }[]> — one AI call per pupil, ≤ 80 words, references the actual wrong answers and the matching misconception entry. Cached on result.summary so reruns don't pay twice.
- exportToCsv(results, worksheet): string — CSV with columns: PupilName, UPN, Mark, OutOf, Pct, Comment, Misconceptions, Date. UK MIS conventions: ISO date, no Excel auto-formatting traps.
Replace ScanMarkDialog with a tabbed dialog:
- Tab 'Single' — today's behaviour, untouched (one image at a time).

- Tab 'Class set' — drop-zone for ≤ 35 images at once, progress bar, live per-pupil tick/cross row, abort button. After completion: aggregate stats, per-pupil mark grid, 'Generate comments' button (calls generateBulkFeedback), 'Export CSV' button.

- Tab 'Voice' — phone-friendly. The teacher holds the camera over a sheet, taps Speak; on result the page reads aloud 'Aisha 8/10, missed Q4 — strong on factorising, slipped on negative coefficients.' via SpeechSynthesis. Opt-in toggle.
Wire it: existing 'Scan & mark' toolbar button on Worksheets.tsx now opens the tabbed dialog; default tab honours the user's last choice via UserPreferencesContext.
Wire Phase B · PB3 reteach: when bulk scan completes, automatically pass `aggregatedResults` to ReteachGapPanel so the re-teach cards render below the marking grid. No extra click.

MIS export: CSV download named `{worksheetTitle}_{className}_{yyyy-mm-dd}.csv`. Include a small modal explaining how to import into SIMS / Bromcom / Arbor (one-line steps for each, sourced from the official import docs URLs — link only, no scraped content).
- client/src/lib/__tests__/scanMarkBatch.test.ts — covers aggregateBatch counts, exportToCsv format stability (snapshot), generateBulkFeedback fallback when AI fails (returns generic comment).
- Snapshot for the 'Class set' tab in 0 / 5 / 30 image states.
files_to_touch: client/src/lib/scan-mark.ts (extend with batch helpers — re-export from scanMarkBatch)
docs/mis-csv-import.md (new — three short paragraphs + links to AQA/Bromcom/Arbor docs)
do_not_touch: ReteachGapPanel internals (PB3 already shipped — only consume aggregatedResults)
acceptance_criteria: Class-set tab processes 30 photos sequentially with progress bar. Each photo's per-question result is appended live; abort button works mid-run.
Aggregate panel shows whole-class accuracy %, top 3 misconceptions, per-pupil traffic-light mark grid.
Generate comments produces one ≤80-word comment per pupil that references at least one wrong answer when there is one. Comments are downloadable as part of the CSV.
CSV export validates against the import preview of at least one of SIMS / Bromcom / Arbor (manual check — note in PR body which MIS was tested).
Voice tab reads a result correctly on Chrome desktop; gracefully degrades to silent on browsers without SpeechSynthesis.
pnpm run check + pnpm run build + pnpm test --run pass.
verification: Manual: scan 6 photos in Class set tab, generate comments, export CSV, open in LibreOffice + a sample MIS import preview.
context_budget_for_fresh_chat: MEDIUM. ScanMarkDialog (~280 LOC) and scan-mark.ts (~140 LOC) can be read in full. Avoid Worksheets.tsx full-read — wire only via existing toolbar button.
